descriptions.text: Dungeon Gold Rush! Scratch off one spot, and depending on the symbol revealed, your next attack against a mob will have varying effects! Guaranteed laughs! One hour cooldown between scratches.

beats.headline: Luck goes both ways
beats.text: For hitting a mob more than seventy-five levels above them, Carl and Donut each get a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box, and each holds a lottery scratch-off ticket. Donut's is red and green, with a troll-like creature throwing gold coins in the air and six spots to scratch, and the safe room will not let her use it. On the back are about twenty symbols, most of them good, like five thousand coins or double damage, a few not, like a mob that splits in two or turns invulnerable for thirty seconds. Don't use it, Carl says, not until they have talked. Fine, says Donut.
